top_signals.title: SoftBank Shares Fluctuate After $7 Billion Loss on Writedown
top_signals.summary: SoftBank Group Corp. shares fluctuated as investors assessed its quarterly net loss and a $3.7 billion writedown over its US data centers, against newfound optimism around artificial intelligence.
